summary: Frontend-only layout verification for the two just-fixed HUD/spectator bugs on 390x844 and 375x667 mobile viewports. BUG 1 (in-game elimination feed card fills full height, aligned with KILLS stat card bottom) is FIXED. BUG 2 (spectator screen with DOUBLE-XP offer still shows the LIVE ELIMINATION FEED clearly AND keeps all 3 footer buttons on-screen) is FIXED. Match regression (auth -> menu -> find-match -> lobby -> active -> self-elim via panic-button -> spectator -> VIEW MY RESULTS -> results screen) works end-to-end. No red screens or critical console errors observed (only harmless font-decoding warnings from the web preview).
critical_code_review_comments: match/[id].tsx line 252: GlassCard now correctly uses innerStyle={{flex:1}} + ScrollView style={{flex:1}} so the feed extends to fill the card. Verified in DOM: feedCard height=188 vs stat column right side ~189 (aligned within 7px, no visible gap).

match/[id].tsx line 1370-1378: specFeed style { flex:1, minHeight:96, padding: space.lg } yields feed height=350 on 390x844 (DXP present) and 173 on 375x667 (DXP present) — well above the 96 minimum in both cases, so the feed is never squeezed to almost nothing.

Spectator footer buttons (spectator-double-xp-btn/results/leave) all measure 52px tall with gap: space.sm and paddingBottom: insets.bottom + space.lg. On 390x844 they land at bottoms 708/768/828 (viewport 844) and on 375x667 at bottoms 531/591/651 (viewport 667) — none clipped.
seed_data_creation: No seed data. Guest callsigns used: LayoutQA, LayoutQA1, DXPQA1, DXPQA2, DXPQA3, SmallQA (ephemeral guest sessions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reliable repro to reach spectator: enter callsign -> find-match-btn -> wait ~8s for lobby countdown -> tap [data-testid=panic-button] every ~300ms; self-elim usually happens after 7–30 taps (danger cap resets only on your own press). DOUBLE-XP is random ~50%; up to 3 attempts is usually enough to surface it. If it doesn't show, tap spectator-leave-btn which shows an ad-overlay (wait ~5s for ad-claim and click it) to return to the menu. VIEW MY RESULTS from spectator loads the same ResultsView used at match-end. IMPORTANT: [data-testid=find-match-btn] renders 2 nodes on the tabs screen (tab + primary CTA), so use `.first` or query_selector_all + first visible element when waiting.
rca_of_issue: Both bugs were layout-only. Root cause of BUG 1: hudRow's feed card previously had a hard maxHeight (~108px) on its inner container, leaving the card taller than its content and clipping the ScrollView area. Fix: GlassCard now supports innerStyle so match/[id].tsx passes innerStyle={{flex:1}}, and the inner ScrollView is style={{flex:1}}, causing the feed to fill the card and its height to match the two stacked stat cards on the right. Root cause of BUG 2: on the spectator page the ScrollView holding the feed had no minimum height and the footer used bulky buttons (56px) without gap tightening, so when the double-XP CTA appeared the feed collapsed to ~a line and the leave button could clip. Fix: specFeed given { flex:1, minHeight:96 }, spectator top section compacted, and footer button heights set to 52 with space.sm gap. Verified in DOM measurements listed above.
